fact: /taskbook-new calls t3_thread_launch with workspaceStrategy.type=worktree. T3 creates and manages the worktree and starts a new thread.
/taskbook-new derives the T3 clientRequestId from the taskbook digest. Retrying unchanged input sends the same request identifier.
A prepared launch rereads the taskbook and verifies its digest, pinned base, worktree when supplied, and expected branch before execution.
When reading a T3 worktree binding, the plugin checks the local Git root and current branch against the binding.
launchTaskbook validates launch parameters with prepareTaskLaunch before requesting the T3 worktree through launchT3Thread.
In an unbound T3 thread, /taskbook calls t3_worktree_handoff with the pinned base, requested branch, and prepared continuation. The original thread resumes in the new worktree.
T3 same-thread handoff requires a new local branch. Taskbook checks the requested name and reports an existing local branch even after its worktree has been removed.
